messages:
alicia: seeing a sudden spike in commit-pool queue length for eu-west dedicated commitments. latency on admit is hitting 4-6s, and some large batch jobs are being rejected with 429s. looks like admission control kicked into a hard-scrub.
jamal: confirmed. metrics: commit-pool/queue_length went from 120 -> 820 in ~18m; admit_latency_p50 4.1s, p95 9.3s. attaching quick query: `sum by (pool) (queue_length{pool=~\"commit-.*\"})` returned heavy tail on commitment-pool-eu-west-2.
marco_sre: infra-bot flagged fairshare pressure and started evicting best-effort slots. Noticed a new customer onboarding with large batched infer requests (batch_size 128) hitting the pool.
infra-bot: *Alert:* commitment-pool-eu-west-2 admission throttled (policy=hard_cap) at 2026-09-15T10:12:49Z. 429_rate=18.4% over 5m.
alicia: who triggered the big batches? product or external customer?
jamal: product says partner test harness started a stress run at 09:58 UTC. It sent ~12k requests with large token counts. They used the dedicated endpoint pinned to the commitment pool.
devex: oof. partner test harness defaulted to max_batch=128. We had warned about large batches and offered a test sandbox.
marco_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily bump enterprise fairshare weight (fast) 2) throttle single-request batch_size > 64 at the ingress proxy (needs small config deploy) 3) divert partner traffic to hosted fallback (requires consent from partner) 4) drain noncritical pools and shift instances (slow, needs capacity in region).
ops_lead: priority is to restore steady admit latency and avoid evictions impacting paying customers. Let's do (1) and (2) immediately. Jamal, roll config change for ingress throttling to cap batch_size to 64 for commitment-pool requests.
jamal: rolling a proxy rule now: `route commit-.* { limit_requests { per_batch max_batch_size=64 } }` will apply to commitment pools. deploying config in 30s.
infra-bot: deploy started: proxy-config/commitment-batch-cap v2 by jamal.
alicia: also notify partner to pause stress tests, and ask them to switch to smaller batches in the meantime.
devex: message sent to partner slack @partner-team: "pausing stress run; we're capping batch sizes on dedicated endpoint until further notice."
marco_sre: applying fairshare bump on commitment-pool-eu-west-2. Increasing dedicated-weight from 0.7 -> 0.85 to favor enterprise tiers. This should free up capacity for pinned customers but may slow best-effort.
infra-bot: fairshare update complete. change_id=ffb3-20260915.
marco_sre: monitoring queue length. initial impact: queue dropped from 820 -> 420 in 4m. p95 admit latency down to 3.2s. 429_rate trending down.
ops_lead: good. track for 30m and then decide if we need to spin additional nodes. Any region constraints?
jamal: eu-west-2 has limited spare GPU capacity this week; adding nodes will likely push procurement autoscaler into long warm-up (20-30m). We can hot-start from a noncritical pool in us-west but cross-region is not ideal due to latency and data locality.
alicia: cost note: if we cold-provision extra GPUs in the region, monthly commit costs will rise ~18% for the quarter. Ops approves if customer SLA at risk.
marco_sre: long-term suggestion: enforce per-customer batch caps on dedicated endpoints and surface recommended batch sizes in onboarding docs. Also add a preflight check that rejects >64 batch sizes for new commit pools by default.
devex: I'll add a blurb to onboarding checklist and update quickstart to recommend streaming smaller batches.
jamal: proxy change is live. Observability dashboards: admit_latency_p50 dropping to 1.8s, queue now 210. 429_rate < 2% on committed endpoints.
infra-bot: incident update: mitigation applied (batch cap + fairshare bump). Next check-in in 30m.
alicia: follow-up action items: 1) devex update docs (devex) 2) automation: preflight reject large batch (marco_sre) 3) postmortem with partner QA to avoid future stress (ops_lead) 4) evaluate reserve-to-burst config for enterprise (alicia).
ops_lead: logging action items. tagging incident severity P2. assigning owners. thanks all. :thumbsup:
marco_sre: will open a runbook PR for preflight and also add a synthetic test that simulates large-batch onboarding to validate admission rules.
devex: created onboarding PR #842 and pinged product for review.
infra-bot: incident resolved (soft) at 2026-09-15T10:48:03Z — queue stabilized. Reopen if regressions seen.
jamal: keeping extra monitoring on until EOW.
alicia: good job everyone. postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
